author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at the recent buzz about gaming and the beginning of the disclosures surrounding the slop they fester with. AI isn't going away anytime soon and a lot of battle lines are being drawn over what's okay and what isn't. Let's dive in. Thanks for watching!

title: It's About To Get Pretty Bad...
